security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A fast desktop UI for Claude Code and Codex, built for Persian and RTL
bundle.longDescription: Glaude runs the Claude Code and Codex CLIs already installed and logged in on this computer, and shows their conversations with correct right-to-left text, permission cards, diffs, terminals, history search and a multi-account manager compatible with mamadoo.
